meta.space: glTF, Y up, metres: (x, z, -y) of Blender. The glb parts sit at rest; a part's node transform is its world transform.
meta.transform: [px, py, pz, qx, qy, qz, qw, sx, sy, sz]; motion[name][frame - first] is the part's world transform at that frame. Moving parts are 21, the stem and pedestal never move.
meta.slider: slider[frame - first]: the Move 1 value, 0 at the first frame and 1 at the last, linear in the frame
meta.sampling: 30 fps. For 60 fps lerp the position and scale and slerp the quaternion between two samples (the quaternion keeps its sign from one sample to the next).

core_glow.what: emission strength of the Core Glow material, per frame. The glb holds colour x strength at the first frame (0.35); in Three.js set emissive to colour and emissiveIntensity to values[frame - first]

camera.what: Promo Camera, per frame, same transform layout; it looks down -Z like a Three.js camera
